title: 第12章 找肖少
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
出租车一路疾驰，很快就停在了江河别墅区的大门外。

    陈阳付了车费，推开车门下车，整理了一下身上的衣服，正准备走向别墅区大门。

    就在这时，一辆熟悉的轿车停在了他的身旁。

    车门打开，宋萌萌从车上走了下来。

    陈阳看着她，脸上满是意外，又转头看了看车里，确认李恒并没有跟着过来，心里不由多了几分疑惑：“嫂子，你怎么来了？恒哥呢？”

    宋萌萌快步冲到陈阳身前，脸上满是担忧，双手紧紧抓住他的胳膊，语气急切：“陈阳，你可千万不要做傻事啊！

    你要想想，你现在这么年轻，就算唐欣悦那个女人不要你了，世界上还有大把好女人等着你，你要是想要，嫂子现在就给你找一个，别一时想不开做出傻事！”

    陈阳心头一暖，看着宋萌萌担忧的模样，才明白她急匆匆赶过来，是担心自己因为唐欣悦的背叛想不开。

    他轻轻拍了拍宋萌萌的手，语气温柔地安慰道：“嫂子，你放心，我还不至于为了一个不值得的女人，就想不开自杀，我还有很多事要做。”

    宋萌萌半信半疑地看着他，眼神里依旧带着担忧：“真的？你没有骗我？”

    陈阳用力点头，语气坚定：“真的，我没有骗你，我就是来这里办点事，办完事就回去。”

    宋萌萌这才松了口气，眼神好奇地看了一眼身后的江河别墅区，又转头看向陈阳，疑惑问：“你到这里来办什么事？

    这里可是富人区，你认识这里面的人？”

    陈阳笑了笑，语气含糊：“嗯，我来这里找个人，办点私事，很快就好。”

    他没有多说，毕竟帮苏冰收账的事情，还是暂时保密比较好。

    说完，陈阳转身走进江河别墅区，按照苏冰给的地址，很快就找到了8号别墅。

    他下意识地开启透视眼，朝着别墅里面望去，却发现整座别墅空空如也，除了门前站着两名保安，里面再也看不到任何人的身影。

    陈阳走上前，对着门前的保安，语气平淡问：“请问，肖少没在家吗？”

    那保安斜睨了陈阳一眼，见他穿着普通，语气顿时变得没好气起来，不耐烦说：“你找他有事？肖少可不是什么人都能见的。”
content_en:
The taxi sped along and soon stopped outside the gate of Jianghe Villa Area.

Chen Yang paid the fare, opened the door and got out of the car, straightened his clothes, and was about to walk to the gate of the villa area.

At this moment, a familiar car stopped next to him.

The car door opened and Song Mengmeng got out of the car.

Chen Yang looked at her with surprise on his face, then turned to look in the car to confirm that Li Heng had not followed. He couldn't help but feel a little more confused: "Sister-in-law, why are you here? Where is Brother Heng?"

Song Mengmeng rushed to Chen Yang quickly, her face full of worry, she grabbed his arm tightly with both hands, and said urgently: "Chen Yang, you must not do anything stupid!

You have to think about it, you are so young now, even if that woman Tang Xinyue doesn't want you, there are still a lot of good women in the world waiting for you. If you want one, my sister-in-law will find one for you now. Don't do stupid things out of your mind!"

Chen Yang felt warm in his heart. Looking at Song Mengmeng's worried look, he realized that she hurried over because she was worried that he would not be able to get over Tang Xinyue's betrayal.

He patted Song Mengmeng's hand gently and comforted her in a gentle tone: "Sister-in-law, don't worry, I won't be tempted to commit suicide for an unworthy woman. I still have a lot to do."

Song Mengmeng looked at him dubiously, her eyes still filled with worry: "Really? You didn't lie to me?"

Chen Yang nodded vigorously and said firmly: "Really, I didn't lie to you. I just came here to do something, and I will go back after finishing it."

Song Mengmeng breathed a sigh of relief, glanced curiously at the Jianghe Villa area behind her, then turned to look at Chen Yang, and asked doubtfully: "What are you doing here?

This is a wealthy area. Do you know the people here?"

Chen Yang smiled and said in a vague tone: "Well, I'm here to find someone to handle some personal matters. I'll be fine soon."

He didn't say much. After all, it was better to keep the matter of helping Su Bing collect the debt a secret for the time being.

After saying that, Chen Yang turned around and walked into the Jianghe Villa area. According to the address given by Su Bing, he quickly found Villa No. 8.

He subconsciously opened his clairvoyance eyes and looked inside the villa, only to find that the entire villa was empty. Except for two security guards standing in front of the door, no one could be seen inside.

Chen Yang stepped forward and asked in a calm tone to the security guard in front of the door: "Excuse me, is Mr. Xiao not at home?"

The security guard glanced sideways at Chen Yang, and when he saw that he was wearing ordinary clothes, his tone suddenly became irritated, and he said impatiently: "You have something to do with him? Mr. Xiao can't meet everyone."
